comment: Ledge cling (docs/DAMAGE.md 'Ledge cling and throwable rubble'), Godot-only and gated on Combat.tuning_active() like every other overlay: a fighter who walks off, or is knocked past, the edge of a platform catches it, hangs and can climb up (JUMP) or let go (CROUCH). This file tunes the catch window and the hang/climb pose distances; nothing here is read by the web game or the parity tests. catch.topMin / topMax = how far the ledge top may sit above the hanging feet; catch.reach = extra metres beyond the body radius a ledge is caught from; catch.maxRise = the highest upward speed that may still catch (0 = only while falling); catch.hangDrop = metres the feet hang below the ledge top; catch.cooldown = seconds before another catch after a climb or a drop; climb.inset = metres the body moves in over the ledge; climb.rise = metres the feet end above the top; drop.push = outward m/s when letting go; bot.climbDelay = seconds a bot hangs before climbing; bot.probeRange = how far a falling bot steers toward a catchable ledge.
